description: Defines the interface INoteRepository for note data operations in the backend, including methods for retrieving, adding, updating, removing notes and saving changes.

classes.name: INoteRepository
classes.description: Interface specifying data access methods for Note entities.

methods.name: GetByIdAsync
methods.description: Asynchronously retrieves a note by its ID and owner ID.

methods.name: GetAllForUserAsync
methods.description: Asynchronously retrieves all notes for a specific user.

methods.name: SaveChangesAsync
methods.description: Asynchronously saves all pending changes to the data store.
